# Vendored libraries

Copied byte for byte from npm (via cdn.jsdelivr.net) on 2026-10-29, so the site loads nothing from a third party.

| File | Package | License |
|---|---|---|
| gsap.min.js, ScrollTrigger.min.js | gsap@3.13.0 | GSAP Standard License (free, https://gsap.com/standard-license) |
| lenis.min.js | lenis@1.3.11 | MIT |
| ../../css/fonts/*.woff2, ../../css/redesign/fonts.css | @fontsource/cinzel@5.3.0, @fontsource/cormorant-garamond@5.3.0 | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |

To update one, download the new pinned version the same way and replace the file.
